note: Price County zoning districts are not published as a queryable ArcGIS service or open file. The only county zoning dataset found is a 2013/2014 file geodatabase zip on geodata.wisc.edu (ESRI Geodatabase, not GeoJSON or shapefile, no license stated). The county GIS viewer (pricecowi.wgxtreme.com) was unreachable and no zoning layer appears in ArcGIS Online or Hub searches. Park Falls publishes only a zoning map PDF. The county's parcel layers carry no zoning field.
